title: A Playlist for the Road
context: Zoe 和朋友 Eli 为一起驾车出游制作歌单，商量歌曲顺序和离线收听。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和练习题均为原创，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: The drive will be more fun with a playlist. Want to make one together?
dialogue.zh: 开车路上有歌单会更有趣。想一起做一个吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Definitely. Let's add songs we both enjoy.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我们把两个人都喜欢的歌加进去吧。

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: I'll start with a few upbeat songs for the morning.
dialogue.zh: 我先加几首适合早上听的欢快歌曲。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Good choice. Can I add some quieter ones for the way back?
dialogue.zh: 选得好。我可以加一些返程时听的安静歌曲吗？

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: Of course. How about putting them near the end?
dialogue.zh: 当然。把它们放在接近结尾的位置怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: That works. This song is on there twice, though.
dialogue.zh: 可以。不过这首歌在里面出现了两次。

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: You're right. I'll take one copy off the list.
dialogue.zh: 你说得对。我把其中一首删掉。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Could we also add the song we heard at the cafe?
dialogue.zh: 我们还能加上在咖啡馆听到的那首歌吗？

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: Yes! I saved its name. Here it is.
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我记下了歌名。就是这首。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Great. Can you share the list so I can add a few more?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你能分享歌单给我，让我再加几首吗？

dialogue.speaker: Zoe
dialogue.en: I just sent it. I'll download the songs before we leave.
dialogue.zh: 刚发给你。我会在出发前下载好歌曲。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Perfect. Then we can listen even if the signal disappears.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。这样即使没信号，我们也能听。

expressions.example: She played an upbeat song while cleaning.
We stopped for coffee on the way back.
Please take milk off the list; we have plenty.
Let's add a few more photos to the album.

expressions.zh: 即使，引出不影响结果的情况。
expressions.example: I'll take a walk even if it is cloudy.

pronunciation: playlist 重读 play；在 songs we 中，songs 末尾的 /z/ 自然接到 we，不必额外加一个音节。

practice.title: Part 1 · Music
practice.prompt: When do you usually listen to music?
practice.answer: I often listen while I travel or clean my room. Upbeat songs give me energy, and quieter music helps me relax.

practice.title: Part 2 · Music for a journey
practice.prompt: Describe music you would choose for a journey. Say who you would travel with, what music you would choose, and why.
practice.answer: For a long car trip, I would make a playlist with my friend. I would start with lively songs to help us feel awake in the morning. We could each add a few favorites, including a song we heard together at a cafe. For the trip home, I would choose slower music. I would download the list before leaving so we could still listen where there is no signal. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Shared choices
practice.prompt: What makes choosing music with other people difficult?
practice.answer: People may have different tastes or want different music at different times. Sharing a list and taking turns to add songs can give everyone a voice.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读制作歌单的对话，再和朋友商量歌曲顺序及离线收听。
practice.answer: Let's start with some upbeat songs. Could you add a few quiet ones for the way back? I'll download the list before we leave.
